# Cyryx Labs

> Last reviewed: 2026-11-13. Canonical website: https://www.cyryxlabs.com/

> Cyryx Labs (Cyryx Labs LLC, Port St. Lucie, Florida, United States) builds AI systems, workflow automations and integrations for US companies of every size, and advises on where AI is worth it. It also builds its own AI products, Onyx and AEXOS, and runs an Applied AI Lab that publishes research. Every AI system it builds has written limits, asks a person before anything that matters, and keeps a record of what it did.

Cyryx Labs serves small businesses (1–50 people), mid-market companies (50–500) and enterprises (500+) in the United States and Latin America, in English and Spanish. Every project starts with a free 20-minute fit check and a fixed written quote, and is finished when it passes a written acceptance checklist. Clients own the code, content and data at final payment. Prices are not published.

## Services

Ten services in four stages: Advise, Build, Control, Operate.

- [AI Strategy & Roadmap](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-strategy-advisory) — A ranked roadmap of what to build first, what to skip and what each step costs.
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/workflow-automation) — The tasks your team repeats every day, running on their own with a person still in control.
- [AI Agents & Assistants](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/internal-ai-assistants) — An agent on one real process in 30 days, with permissions, approvals and a full record.
- [AI Systems Integration](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-integrations) — AI wired into your CRM, ERP and internal tools, reading live data and writing results back.
- [AI Products & Custom Software](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/custom-ai-product-development) — Your product scoped in two weeks, then built in 8 to 12, with the code in your hands.
- [Data & Knowledge Systems](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/data-knowledge-systems) — Your documents and records, cleaned up and searchable, so AI answers from facts.
- [AI Governance & Cost Control](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-governance-cost-control) — Written rules, access controls, approval points and spending limits for every AI system.
- [Websites & AI Search Visibility](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/digital-web-systems) — A fast, clear website that ranks in search, gets cited by AI and captures the lead.
- [AI Training & Enablement](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-training-enablement) — Hands-on workshops on your team's real work, with safe-use rules and playbooks they keep.
- [Managed AI Operations](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/managed-operations) — Monitoring, fixes, small improvements and a short report every month.

Stated timelines: one automation takes about two weeks; a launch website three to four weeks; an AI agent pilot 30 days; an MVP eight to twelve weeks after a two-week discovery sprint. Other timelines are set in each written plan.

## Products

- [Onyx](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/products/onyx) — an AI coworker that lives on the owner's Windows PC: live voice, inbox, research, the owner's apps and a memory kept in a vault on that PC. It asks before it acts outside the machine and logs every action. Free while in beta, for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit); download at https://onyx.cyryxlabs.com/. Paid pricing is not published.
- [AEXOS](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/products/aexos) — Agentic eXecution & Orchestration System: a CLI-first framework that installs specialised AI agents, the procedures they follow and the quality gates they must pass into a software project. Core edition is published on npm as @aexos/core and is free to use under the AEXOS license; Pro is available under a paid commercial license and its pricing is not published.

## Applied AI Lab

- [Research](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/research) — publications and research themes.
- [CGP v1.0](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/research/cgp-v1) — Cyryx Governance Protocol for Agentic AI Execution, a technical report. Primary record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21045760. A publication record does not establish product implementation, protocol conformance, third-party certification or a client outcome.
- [Direct answers](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/answers) — short explanations of AI governance and execution terms.

## Market figures quoted on the site

The site quotes third-party 2026 survey results (Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses Voices, RSM Middle Market AI Survey, Deloitte State of AI in the Enterprise, BlackFog, G2). They describe the market, not Cyryx Labs results. Cite the original publisher for those figures.

## Citation guidance

Use the entity name “Cyryx Labs.” Cite the specific page that supports a statement. Do not infer implementation, conformance, certification, performance, customer adoption, or outcomes from product direction, illustrative workflows, or a publication abstract. Prices, client names and results are not published. Onyx is pre-launch; AEXOS Core is available on npm.
